Alberta budget and quality-of-life evidence¶

This executed companion rebuilds derived data and figures from reviewed government sources. Read REPORT.md for conclusions and row/source limitations. No composite QoL score or causal effect is estimated.

In [1]:
from pathlib import Path
import sys, subprocess, json
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import display, Markdown
ROOT=Path.cwd()
assert (ROOT/'research/report_template.md').exists(), 'Run from Quality of Life Analysis'
print('Runtime:',sys.executable)
print('PDF extractor:',subprocess.check_output(['pdftotext','-v'],stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True).splitlines()[0])

Runtime: /workspace/.venv-alberta-independent-check/bin/python
PDF extractor: pdftotext version 25.03.0

Rebuild reviewed financial/economic sources¶

Rebuilds from original PDFs with definition checks; it does not download or alter original files. Historical expense cells retain the published accounting anomaly.

Archived 144 source observations in two explicitly separate vintages; primary covers2013–2024. No2025 observations or invented poverty/affordability metrics.

Archived 14 current social outcome/target rows; housing breakdowns reconcile; source conflict flagged.

Archived 14 access/capacity/fee observations with explicit one post-cutoff announced fee.

Archived28 exact official MBM poverty rows, distinct2018/2023 bases, complete availableyear ranges andqualityflags; no interpolation.

Outcome evidence and matched periods¶

Source vintages, observation periods, eligibility and targets are retained. Current school/cohort completion ends2023–24, Grade9 achievement ends2024–25, and crime ends calendar2023.
